issues.display_title: Issue #1122: Blue Line editor: save panorama locations via Floormap API
issues.main_description_html:
Follow-up to #1111 (where Save was disabled because GoThru had no endpoint to persist coordinates).
Backend counterpart: GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#195.

With the backend proxy in place (API-GO#195), the Blue Line editor can now persist moved panorama coordinates back to GoThru.

Scope

  1. Server Action (src/actions/blueLine.ts):
    • Add saveBlueLineTourLocationsAction(mid: number, tourKey: string, locations: { id: string; lat: number; lng: number }[]).
    • Call the Floormap Go API proxy endpoint PUT /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas.
  2. Editor View (src/components/blue-line/BlueLineEditorView.tsx):
    • Add isSaving state and save handler.
    • Collect updated/placed panorama positions and call saveBlueLineTourLocationsAction.
    • On success: set hasUnsavedChanges = false, reset baseline history frame, and display success toast notification.
    • On error: display error toast and keep hasUnsavedChanges = true.
  3. Navigation Bar (src/components/blue-line/editor/BlueLineEditorNav.tsx):
    • Enable the Save button when hasUnsavedChanges && !isSaving.
    • Show loading spinner inside the Save button while saving.
    • Update tooltip and status label ("Saving…", "Saved", "Changes aren’t saved").
  4. Testing:
    • Update BlueLineEditorNav.test.tsx and BlueLineEditorView.test.tsx.
    • Add unit test for saveBlueLineTourLocationsAction in blueLine.test.ts.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Save button is active when there are unsaved changes.
  • Clicking Save triggers batch update through the Floormap API proxy.
  • Status updates accurately (Saving… -> Saved), with toast feedback.
  • Reloading after saving reflects the updated coordinates.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit green.
